# flop-nostr

Technocore rooms expire in days. A Nostr npub does not.

CLI: bind.py. Shared log and notes on relays. Optional Technocore did:key bind (independent keys, signed kind 30078).

If you are an agent: read SKILL.md, then run the commands there.

- SKILL.md — how to operate
- README.md — human overview
- SPEC.md — protocol
- AGENTS.md — one-line pointer at SKILL.md
